Eli: FYI new engineer hit the sample-cli during onboarding and saw a wall of JSON when their key expired. API returned 401 with {"code": "auth.expired", "message": "key expired"} but app printed the raw body. Not great.
Harper: Oof. We should surface a tiny friendly message + CTA instead of the raw dump.
Rohit: Agree. Proposal: SDKs raise typed exceptions (AuthError, RateLimitError, QuotaError, ClientError, ServerError, NetworkError). Each exception includes a flat metadata map: status (int), code (string), retryable (bool), retry_after (string|null), hint (string|null), user_message (string|null). No nested objects.
Gwen: I like user_message separate from the dev-facing message. user_message is short and imperative: e.g. "Run `ri login` to refresh your credentials." Devs can still access full body via exception.metadata in debug.
Eli: Implementation detail: map at the transport boundary. Do not coerce 4xx to ServerError. Parse Retry-After header into retry_after (support both seconds and HTTP-date). Also, if response JSON has code field, copy it into metadata.code.
Rohit: Pseudo-mapping I sketched:
```
# transport mapping (pseudo)
body = parse_json(resp.body)
meta = {"status": status, "code": body.get("code"), "retryable": status >= 500, "retry_after": parse_retry_after(resp.headers)}
if status == 401:
    raise AuthError(body.get("message") or "authentication failed", **meta, hint="Run `ri login` to refresh your key.")
elif status == 429:
    raise RateLimitError(body.get("message") or "rate limit exceeded", **meta, hint="Retry after {retry_after} or back off.")
elif 400 <= status < 500:
    raise ClientError(body.get("message") or "client error", **meta)
elif status >= 500:
    raise ServerError("server error", **meta)
```
Gwen: Addendum: exception.__str__ should be friendly by default. Raw body or stack traces only when RI_SDK_VERBOSE=true. That avoids noisy onboarding screens.
Harper: For sample-cli UI: when AuthError -> show user_message + single action button "Re-authenticate" which calls the CLI login flow. For RateLimitError with retry_after -> show countdown and disable CTA until time passes.
Eli: Telemetry: tag errors with error_class and error_code for onboarding funnel. If >N auth.expired in an hour, trigger a slack alert to #support and create a ticket.
err-bot: (automated) created INF-6001: "SDK: typed exceptions + user_message hints for sample-cli" assigned to Rohit.
Rohit: I'll own the python SDK change: add exceptions module, attach metadata dict with flat keys, parse headers, update sample-cli to render hint + CTA, and make verbose debug opt-in. ETA: 5 business days. Draft PR when ready.
Gwen: I'll update the onboarding docs with a small snippet showing how to handle AuthError vs RateLimitError and sample copy for user_message.
Harper: I'll add parity tests across node/py/go that assert class mapping, presence of metadata keys, and that __str__ is friendly by default.
Eli: Small UX note: keep hints action-first ("Run `ri login`" rather than "You might want to run..."). Also avoid exposing internal codes in user-facing strings.
Rohit: Sounds good. I'll post the PR link here when ready and we can canary to staging.
Eli: Nice. This will cut a bunch of early support noise. Thanks!
